editorial:
If you are looking for a fresh spin on a holiday classic, this movie delivers a warm and funny take on Charles Dickens' famous story. Ben Scrooge is a grumpy man who hates Christmas, and his journey through the past, present, and future is told with a queer sensibility that feels both heartfelt and playful. The film mixes comedy, music, and romance in a way that keeps things light while still landing emotional moments. It is the kind of movie you can watch with friends or family when you want something cozy but different from the usual holiday fare.

The acting is solid, the pacing moves along nicely, and the musical numbers add a fun energy that keeps you engaged. Some scenes feel a little low-budget, and a few jokes do not land perfectly, but the overall charm makes up for it. If you enjoy holiday movies with a unique twist and a big heart, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or pick up the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ben Scrooge wakes up on Christmas morning transformed after his visit from the three spirits. He realizes he has been given a second chance and rushes out to make amends. He reconnects with the people he pushed away, including his nephew and former partner, and embraces the holiday spirit. The twist is that his journey was not just about Christmas, but about accepting himself and the love around him. The movie ends on a joyful note with Ben celebrating with friends and family, showing that it is never too late to change.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves holiday movies with a unique twist and a big heart.
